title: My Isekai Life UK Blu-ray Will Be Released on Monday
content: "As a novice level Monster Tamer, Yuji would normally be one of the last ones chosen when putting together a dungeon delving party. However, thanks to a clever trick involving a bunch of slimes, Yuji has also absorbed the archived knowledge of a great Sage and secretly gained an incredibly powerful second class!

title: Anime Times Streams So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin?, 7 More Anime in India
content: Amazon Prime Video 's Anime Times ' Indian Instagram account announced on Tuesday that it will stream the following anime in October: • The second season of the television anime of Yūgo Kobayashi's Aoashi manga.

title: Muse India Streams The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2 Anime
content: The Muse India Instagram account has also posted countdowns for second season of the television anime of writer Buncololi and illustrator Kantoku 's Sasaki and Peeps ( Sasaki and Pichan ) novels, where it has not confirmed the broadcast platforms for the season. Crunchyroll will stream the anime season in India.
author: ANN

title: The New Denpa Men Game Ends Service on December 7
content: The game has halted sales of in-game Jewel currency and other paid items on Tuesday. The website will detail information regarding refunds of unused in-game currency after the game ends service. The game launched as a timed exclusive for Nintendo Switch in July 2024 and later got releases on iOS and Android devices.
author: ANN

title: 10 Years Ago, Pokemon Released Its Coolest Anime Yet & It Needs to Return
content: While most anime fans might be familiar with the adventures of Ash Ketchum in the anime adaptation of Pokemon , following him on his decades long journey to become a Pokemon champion across every new region that gets introduced to the franchise, his adventure isn’t the only story to be animated.
author: ComicBook

title: Hunter X Hunter Manga Creator Yoshihiro Togashi to Limit Work Due to Physical/Mental Health Issues
content: Togashi's Hunter X Hunter manga went back on hiatus on September 7 after having resumed serialization on June 29. The manga left off in its 420th chapter, and Togashi recently posted an update on September 15 stating that he had finished the manuscript for the 428th chapter.
author: ANN
